A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] worked as a '''black market merchant''' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], and sought help tracking down lost relics from a dig on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The smuggler was first mentioned in the Treasure Hunting Crew Skill Mission "Smuggler's Dig", in ''[[Star Wars Legends]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
